text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Jordan. It's not every day we see
you doing
solo training.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know. I guess I'm just in the
mood or
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Interesting attitude... But whatever
works. Let's
go!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, what a run! The wind felt great!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uhh... What's up, City? Everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You know... It's a bit weird having you
just staring
at me like that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you notice? You're totally fine,
even after
running as hard as we did.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh... No way! You're right! I'm not tired
at all!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What is this, a legit miracle?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that trainer of yours must be
doing
something right.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well... That might be it. Trainer can be a
bit
intense and annoying, but... I more or
less get
what I'm supposed to do.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep that between us, okay? Last
thing I
need is my trainer getting a big
head.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm thirsty! I'm gonna go get
something
to drink!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And she still has energy to run.
